# why_this_panel: a K+ titration at 0, 5, 10, 25, 50 and 100 mM on two parent sequences plus
#   G-disrupted mutants, all at 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 5 uM DNA, 26 C, with CD melting from
#   20-90 C. Two parents is far too few to say anything about folding accuracy, but the titration
#   is an out-of-sample test of the one capability no competing tool has: whether predicted
#   stability moves correctly with cation concentration on sequences and from a laboratory that
#   had nothing to do with the training data. Report it as a condition-response panel and as
#   nothing else.
# extraction_status: PENDING -- fill one row per (sequence, KCl concentration). FAM230F has a
#   parallel-compatible CD spectrum and an apparent Tm near 51 C; FAM230E has a mixed spectrum
#   with no clean single transition, so leave its observed_tm_c empty rather than fitting a
#   number the authors did not report. The mutants are the internal negative control.
# read_out_as: within-sequence rank correlation between predicted Tm and K+ concentration, and
#   the predicted parent-minus-mutant difference. Not an accuracy claim on two sequences.
